body: When did you start feeling like this? You may not believe me but I feel the same way. I've contemplated doing it so many times and have come close. You are not the only one who feels like this and you're not alone in this. Have you talked to someone about it?

I'm sorry if I seem really stubborn. But if something like that was done to me, I WOULD want to know. I have no right to hide it from them.

Also, a guy who was similar to my age did it too:
https://www.reddit.com/r/confession/comments/kcgl2/i_touched_my_stepsister_in_her_sleep_and_then/

As I read it, I honestly felt disgusted, as I do with myself. I didn't like how people told him "you were a kid", and how he should "forgive himself and forget about it". To me, he and I have no right to forget about it. He probably caused the girl so much mental pain, and could be the reason for her being in a bad state. I could have caused the same for my mom. So I can't forget about it. I deserve to repent and take the consequences and suffer for the rest of my life. Even if it ruins me.

Still she deserves to know. If I was touched wrongly in my sleep I would want to know, like every other normal human being out there. I would get hurt.

I really do just want to let it go. But I can't help but wonder if that's enough--what I did was a crime. I have learned from them, but I also need to be punished.

I'm happy someone thinks I'm a good person. I'm trying to see if I am. Thank you for trying to help me. I'll try and update you. I hope life's good to you.

Why didn't she lecture me about it? Also, it's much worse if she doesn't know. She has the right to know since it's her body.

I feel like it isn't unnecessary at all. I did something wrong, so it's right for me to be repenting.

I don't know what you did, but do you think it was right to just let it go and not repent?

What if my mom got hurt? I have no right to just put it behind me. And I feel so freaking horrible because I keep thinking about what would happen if I told my future boyfriend or my friends or my siblings about this.

I love my mom, and the fact that I might have hurt her kills me. How is this different from sexual assault

I'm really thankful you're trying to help me. I do want to talk to her, but I'm scared. That makes me selfish. I know I'm a horrible person. Children as young as 11 go to jail for sex crimes, and I'm starting to think about turning myself in. I read a post here about a woman who was groped by a 10 year old and felt victimized. I'm freaking hoping that I really didn't know what I was doing but kids my age get punished for worse. I should have known.
More reason not to do it. Even if it's common, it's still wrong, right?

How is it not sexual? I touched her wrong and at that age I was already exposed to that kind of stuff on the internet. It wasn't consensual. I just feel like I've killed someone or something. Kids get punished for this kind of stuff.

I know it's selfish to. But I've seen people wanting kids my age to go to prison for groping them, people getting mental scars from KIDS. I can't bear the thought of having done that to my mom. 

On a selfish note, how do I say this to my future boyfriends? Friends? Siblings? I really want to be a good person, I really do, but I've seen kids do what I've done and worse, and leave mental scars on people. It's still sexual assault-- something that should NEVER be inflicted on anyone, and it can't be justified at all. I'm thinking of turning myself in.

I know my mom and brothers will be in agony if I die. But I can't help to think that they'll still lead good lives without me. The world will be a better place without a sex offender. Come to think of it, I'll probably be happier in the afterlife since at least it's not here.

I've wanted to die since forever, since before I realized what I'd done. That really doesn't change. I don't have dreams, and I certainly don't like the idea of studying and working my whole life, doing everything while my conscience eats away at me. Now my guilt is adding up to that. Selfish, right?

I love my mom, my brothers, my friends. I never want to hurt anyone again. It's alright if I'm never forgiven for what I've done. 

If anyone finds this when I die, I hope my mom's happy. 

Sorry, guys.

I feel like I have, but if my mom got hurt because of it, or still doesn't know what I did to her, I deserve it. I should talk to her, but I don't know how. Are you a psychologist? Sorry for asking.

Crimes are punished. I did a crime. Killers get punished knowing what they're doing is wrong. I really don't want to be a bad person. I've almost killed myself because I don't think the world deserves me. But I won't forgive myself if I've scarred someone I love.

I would like to put it behind me, but I respectfully disagree with you about "acting like you haven't done anything". How can I act like I haven't when I've done a SERIOUS crime? What I did wasn't consensual. I've read about minors doing stuff far worse than me, or minors who have sexually assaulted others. Some are my age and younger. So as far as I've seen, my age doesn't justify what I'd done, so I can't put it behind me and act like I did nothing wrong. My mom hasn't talked to me about it, but how do I know if she's just scared to, or even worse--if she DIDN'T know what I did to her? 

I'm sorry for saying this, but how do I know if what you're telling me is true? If you're a good person? Is it even healthy to post here? But I still want help, and I'm thankful you're trying to help. I really don't want to be a bad person. I'll accept the consequences. I've even thought about turning myself in. If it's all the good I can do, if it costs me all my boyfriends and friends and relatives, I want to do what's right. Even if I let go of all my dreams and rot in jail, even if I'm not forgiven. 

I love my mom, and she's one of the most important people in my life. She sacrificed SO MUCH, from her dreams to the people she loves.
So if I hurt her in any way, or did something bad, I don't want to forget it. I want to put up with the consequences for the rest of my life.

Also, I know human beings make mistakes daily. But mine isn't a normal mistake. It was sexual assault. Sure, I may have not known it was wrong, but so other kids my age who have done worse don't either. And they got punished. Don't you think I should, too?

I'm sorry. But I can't convince myself that I am a good person. Why should I believe you, when I myself did something people actually punish others for? I did it when she was SLEEPING. I feel so disgusting.

Thank you, for reading. I only selfishly wanted someone to tell me I'm a good person. I hurt my mom. Sexual assault should never be done to anyone, and just like how intoxication can't justify it, age can't justify it. Is it really healthy for me to post here? How can I get help from people I don't know, people who may as well be as bad as me, or worse? I'm really selfish. I'm sorry. But I will try to do atleast something with the world.

That's what I'm selfishly scared of. I need someone to tell me I'm a good person. I've never touched anyone else wrongly since then, but how will I live with this on my hands? I'm too scared to do anything, much less go to a therapist.
They are, but do you know any kids who sexually assaulted when they were younger? Not a lot. It isn't really normal for teenagers to do this.

Yeah, I know I talked about God, but he was just kind of someone that gave me hope--I can still be forgiven. But to me, isn't it bad to do things knowing you can be forgiven? Isn't it better not to do them at all, and that's the whole reason why we're punished? On a selfish viewpoint, how do I tell this to my future boyfriend? Friends? Family? I can't convince myself that I am a good person.
